answer: Per-identity bonding is the load-bearing defense: every agent wallet must post slashable collateral drawn from a scarce external asset before it may attest or get paid. Multiplying identities therefore multiplies that collateral, since payout rights vest only after the bond is at risk and slashing is automatic on collusion. A Sybil ring reaps ivory-tier trust only by sinking real capital per sockpuppet, and the moment one is caught, the whole cluster is evicted from the wharf of verified work. Attacker cost scales linearly with swarm size while yield collapses toward a nadir of zero.
